# 1. Requirements
```{r bootstrap-stability-pd-vs-fpdc}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "mclust",
  "cluster", "clusterCrit", "FPDclustering"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mclust)
library(cluster)
library(clusterCrit)
library(FPDclustering)
```

# 2. Settings
```{r settings}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

k_to_compare <- c(2, 3, 4, 5)
q_range <- 2:4
n_boot <- 30
bootstrap_replace <- TRUE
sample_fraction <- 1.0
fpdc_nstart <- 20

set.seed(123)

dir.create("output/bootstrap_stability_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/bootstrap_stability_cache", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 3. Helpers
```{r helpers}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

load_cached_pd_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val,
                                 cache_dir = "output/pd_cache") {
  cache_file <- file.path(
    cache_dir,
    paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
  )

  if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  readRDS(cache_file)
}

load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val, q_vals = 2:4,
                                        cache_dir = "output/fpdc_cache") {
  candidates <- list()

  for (q_val in q_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      cache_dir,
      paste0("fpdc_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)

      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
        k = k_val,
        q = q_val,
        model = cached$model,
        silhouette = cached$Silhouette,
        ch = cached$CH,
        prob_silh = cached$ProbSilh,
        file = cache_file
      )
    }
  }

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  candidate_df <- bind_rows(lapply(candidates, function(x) {
    data.frame(
      q = x$q,
      Silhouette = x$silhouette,
      CH = x$ch,
      ProbSilh = x$prob_silh
    )
  }))

  best_idx <- with(candidate_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
  candidates[[best_idx]]
}


bootstrap_indices <- function(n, replace = TRUE, fraction = 1.0) {
  sample(seq_len(n), size = max(2, floor(fraction * n)), replace = replace)
}

bootstrap_ari_vs_reference <- function(reference_labels, boot_labels, sampled_idx) {
  sampled_unique <- sort(unique(sampled_idx))

  if (length(sampled_unique) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  boot_first_pos <- match(sampled_unique, sampled_idx)
  boot_labels_unique <- boot_labels[boot_first_pos]
  ref_labels_unique <- reference_labels[sampled_unique]

  if (length(unique(boot_labels_unique)) < 2 || length(unique(ref_labels_unique)) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  adjustedRandIndex(ref_labels_unique, boot_labels_unique)
}

compute_avg_silhouette <- function(x, labels) {
  if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  dmat <- dist(x)
  sil <- silhouette(as.integer(labels), dmat)
  mean(sil[, 3])
}

compute_ch <- function(x, labels) {
  if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  intCriteria(
    traj = x,
    part = as.integer(labels),
    crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
  )$calinski_harabasz
}
```

# 4. Main bootstrap loop
```{r main}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN LOOP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bootstrap_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing embedding file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }

  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_tag, "\n")

  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1] |> as.matrix()
  embedding_matrix <- scale(embedding_matrix)

  n <- nrow(embedding_matrix)

  for (k_val in k_to_compare) {
    cat("  Bootstrapping PD and FPDC for k =", k_val, "\n")

    pd_cached <- load_cached_pd_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val = k_val,
      cache_dir = "output/pd_cache"
    )

    fpdc_cached <- load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val = k_val,
      q_vals = q_range,
      cache_dir = "output/fpdc_cache"
    )

    if (is.null(pd_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing PD cache for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }

    if (is.null(fpdc_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing FPDC cache for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }

    pd_reference_labels <- pd_cached$labels
    fpdc_reference_labels <- fpdc_cached$model$label
    best_q <- fpdc_cached$q

    if (length(pd_reference_labels) != n || length(fpdc_reference_labels) != n) {
      cat("    Label length mismatch for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }

    boot_cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/bootstrap_stability_cache",
      paste0("bootstrap_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (file.exists(boot_cache_file)) {
      cat("    Loading cached bootstrap results for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
      boot_summary <- readRDS(boot_cache_file)
    } else {
      pd_boot_ari <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      fpdc_boot_ari <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      pd_boot_sil <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      fpdc_boot_sil <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      pd_boot_ch <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      fpdc_boot_ch <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      pd_status <- rep("ok", n_boot)
      fpdc_status <- rep("ok", n_boot)

      for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
        cat("    Bootstrap replicate", b, "of", n_boot, "\n")

        sampled_idx <- bootstrap_indices(
          n = n,
          replace = bootstrap_replace,
          fraction = sample_fraction
        )

        x_boot <- embedding_matrix[sampled_idx, , drop = FALSE]

        pd_model_boot <- tryCatch(
          suppressWarnings(PDC(x_boot, k = k_val)),
          error = function(e) {
            pd_status[b] <<- paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
            NULL
          }
        )

        if (!is.null(pd_model_boot)) {
          pd_labels_boot <- pd_model_boot$label
          pd_boot_ari[b] <- bootstrap_ari_vs_reference(
            reference_labels = pd_reference_labels,
            boot_labels = pd_labels_boot,
            sampled_idx = sampled_idx
          )
          pd_boot_sil[b] <- compute_avg_silhouette(x_boot, pd_labels_boot)
          pd_boot_ch[b] <- compute_ch(x_boot, pd_labels_boot)
        }

        fpdc_model_boot <- tryCatch(
          suppressWarnings(FPDC(x_boot, k_val, fpdc_nstart, best_q)),
          error = function(e) {
            fpdc_status[b] <<- paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
            NULL
          }
        )

        if (!is.null(fpdc_model_boot)) {
          fpdc_labels_boot <- fpdc_model_boot$label
          fpdc_boot_ari[b] <- bootstrap_ari_vs_reference(
            reference_labels = fpdc_reference_labels,
            boot_labels = fpdc_labels_boot,
            sampled_idx = sampled_idx
          )
          fpdc_boot_sil[b] <- compute_avg_silhouette(x_boot, fpdc_labels_boot)
          fpdc_boot_ch[b] <- compute_ch(x_boot, fpdc_labels_boot)
        }
      }

      boot_summary <- list(
        embedding = embedding_tag,
        k = k_val,
        fpdc_best_q = best_q,
        n_boot = n_boot,
        bootstrap_replace = bootstrap_replace,
        sample_fraction = sample_fraction,
        pd_reference_silhouette = pd_cached$avg_silhouette,
        pd_reference_ch = pd_cached$ch,
        pd_reference_prob_silh = pd_cached$prob_silh,
        fpdc_reference_silhouette = fpdc_cached$silhouette,
        fpdc_reference_ch = fpdc_cached$ch,
        fpdc_reference_prob_silh = fpdc_cached$prob_silh,
        pd_boot_ari = pd_boot_ari,
        fpdc_boot_ari = fpdc_boot_ari,
        pd_boot_sil = pd_boot_sil,
        fpdc_boot_sil = fpdc_boot_sil,
        pd_boot_ch = pd_boot_ch,
        fpdc_boot_ch = fpdc_boot_ch,
        pd_status = pd_status,
        fpdc_status = fpdc_status
      )

      saveRDS(boot_summary, boot_cache_file)
    }

    bootstrap_results[[length(bootstrap_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      embedding = boot_summary$embedding,
      k = boot_summary$k,
      fpdc_best_q = boot_summary$fpdc_best_q,
      n_boot = boot_summary$n_boot,
      pd_reference_silhouette = boot_summary$pd_reference_silhouette,
      pd_reference_ch = boot_summary$pd_reference_ch,
      pd_reference_prob_silh = boot_summary$pd_reference_prob_silh,
      fpdc_reference_silhouette = boot_summary$fpdc_reference_silhouette,
      fpdc_reference_ch = boot_summary$fpdc_reference_ch,
      fpdc_reference_prob_silh = boot_summary$fpdc_reference_prob_silh,
      pd_bootstrap_ari_mean = mean(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_ari_sd = sd(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_ari_median = median(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      fpdc_bootstrap_ari_mean = mean(boot_summary$fpdc_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      fpdc_bootstrap_ari_sd = sd(boot_summary$fpdc_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      fpdc_bootstrap_ari_median = median(boot_summary$fpdc_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_sil_mean = mean(boot_summary$pd_boot_sil, na.rm = TRUE),
      fpdc_bootstrap_sil_mean = mean(boot_summary$fpdc_boot_sil, na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_ch_mean = mean(boot_summary$pd_boot_ch, na.rm = TRUE),
      fpdc_bootstrap_ch_mean = mean(boot_summary$fpdc_boot_ch, na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_valid_boot = sum(is.finite(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari)),
      fpdc_valid_boot = sum(is.finite(boot_summary$fpdc_boot_ari)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

# 5. Final table
```{r final}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bootstrap_results_df <- bind_rows(bootstrap_results) %>%
  arrange(embedding, k)

print(bootstrap_results_df)

write.csv(
  bootstrap_results_df,
  file = file.path(
    "output/bootstrap_stability_results",
    "bootstrap_stability_pd_vs_fpdc_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# 6. Plot bootstrap stability
```{r plot-bootstrap-stability}
plot_df <- bootstrap_results_df %>%
  select(
    embedding,
    k,
    pd_bootstrap_ari_mean,
    fpdc_bootstrap_ari_mean
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(pd_bootstrap_ari_mean, fpdc_bootstrap_ari_mean),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "mean_bootstrap_ari"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = dplyr::case_when(
      method == "pd_bootstrap_ari_mean" ~ "PD",
      method == "fpdc_bootstrap_ari_mean" ~ "FPDC",
      TRUE ~ method
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = k, y = mean_bootstrap_ari, color = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ embedding, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap stability by embedding and k",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Mean bootstrap ARI",
    color = "Method"
  )
```

# 7. Inspect one cached bootstrap result
```{r inspect-one-bootstrap-run}
embedding_tag <- "user_embeddings_128"
k_val <- 3

cache_file <- file.path(
  "output/bootstrap_stability_cache",
  paste0("bootstrap_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
)

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  boot_obj <- readRDS(cache_file)

  inspect_df <- data.frame(
    replicate = seq_len(boot_obj$n_boot),
    pd_boot_ari = boot_obj$pd_boot_ari,
    fpdc_boot_ari = boot_obj$fpdc_boot_ari,
    pd_boot_sil = boot_obj$pd_boot_sil,
    fpdc_boot_sil = boot_obj$fpdc_boot_sil,
    pd_status = boot_obj$pd_status,
    fpdc_status = boot_obj$fpdc_status
  )

  print(inspect_df)
}
```
